definition:
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  box rgb(200,220,255) Client Zone
    participant U as User
    participant W as WebApp
  end
  box rgb(60,60,60) Server Zone
    participant S as Service
  end
  U->>W: click
  critical Establish connection
    W->>S: connect
  option network timeout
    W->>W: retry with backoff
  option credentials rejected
    W-->>U: show login
  end
  break cache miss
    S->>S: recompute
  end
  W-->>U: render
intent: Combines autonumber + box participant grouping (with hardcoded rgb() box fills, one LIGHT rgb(200,220,255) and one DARK rgb(60,60,60)) + critical/option + break. The two boxes are the theme-adaptation test in miniature: participant label text is drawn ON the box fill, so the light box must stay legible in dark theme and the dark box must stay legible in light. Both fills are computable. Also re-probes wave 1's dropped-else-label defect via critical/option.
